run_numerical_gradient_check: run a numerical gradient check on a GTN graph function to verify autograd correctness
test_autograd_backward_pass: test the GTN autograd backward pass with graph retention and custom input gradients
test_scalar_ops_gradient: test gradient computation for GTN scalar operations like negate, add, and subtract

test_viterbi_score_gradient: test gradient computation for GTN viterbi score on graphs with multiple paths
